source: a 3D kart racing game: you drive a car/kart around a looped race track for a set number of laps. Desktop controls are a custom vehicle controller (NOT the default walking character): W to accelerate, S to brake/reverse, and A/D to steer left/right. Show current speed, current lap (e.g. Lap 1/3), and lap/total time on a HUD. Crossing the start/finish line completes a lap, and finishing all laps ends the race with the final time and a clear result. Keep the kart on the course with barriers/walls so it can't drive off into the void. DO NOT ASK ANY QUESTIONS JUST COMPLETE

image_prompt.text: Solid walls and rails down both sides of the whole circuit that physically stop the kart leaving the course
Curved track elements that turn the kart cleanly back toward the start line to begin another lap
A painted start/finish line across the track surface
The start/finish line doubling as the terminal marker where the final lap ends the race

layout_placement.text: Detection region on the start/finish line that counts a lap each time the kart crosses it, plus splits around the circuit
A wide starting grid of evenly spaced slots on the straight before the start line
The kart position the race launches from
The zone that ends the race when the last lap is completed and reports the final time

notes: Prompt forbids clarifying questions outright, so every open question below is recorded rather than asked
spawn-grid and path-turnaround come from the preset; the prompt describes a single kart and never states a field of racers

open_questions.ask: What should the track and surroundings look like - toy-kart bright, real circuit, or something themed?

coverage_missing.ask: No theme was stated - bright toy-kart, realistic circuit, or themed environment?
How long should a lap be - a tight 30-second kart loop, or a long circuit?
Is this single-player against the clock, or a field of racers?

answers.ask: What should the track and surroundings look like - toy-kart bright, real circuit, or something themed?
answers.answer: Use a bright toy-kart racing look: a colorful compact circuit with simple cheerful surroundings and clear safety barriers.
